entries.source: Each invite has a personal link you can share directly:
entries.translation: Varje inbjudan har en personlig länk som du kan dela direkt:

entries.source: Copy invite link | Copy all links ({count})

entries.translation: Det gick inte att kopiera inbjudningslänken

entries.source: This invite link is no longer valid
It may have expired or been replaced. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.
entries.translation: Den kan ha gått ut eller ersatts. Be personen som bjöd in dig om en ny länk.

entries.source: This invite was sent to a different email
entries.translation: Inbjudan skickades till en annan e-postadress

entries.source: You're signed in as {email}. Sign in with the email that received this invite to accept it.
entries.translation: Du är inloggad som {email}. Logga in med e-postadressen som tog emot inbjudan för att godkänna den.

entries.source: This invite was sent to a different email address than the one you're signed in with. Sign in with the email that received it.
entries.translation: Inbjudan skickades till en annan e-postadress än den du är inloggad med. Logga in med e-postadressen som tog emot den.
